headline: Non-citizen voter protections policy and upcoming charter amendments, plus youth investment presentations.
summary: The agenda lists a policy on non-citizen voter protections and upcoming charter amendments, presented by Councilor Allie Schachter. It also covers a memo on investing in Burlington's youth, with presentations from four city and library groups.
